title: Give OLY-B-O5-02 a mechanism: restart cost, loss and fixes in status
summary: Extend the existing `athena restart` record (cost, minutes, tokens, lost, via) so each restart's cost, losses and Athena fixes are surfaced by a new `athena status` line, and record that as OLY-B-O5-02's mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml. Audience: Athena's owner reading `athena status` and the spec gap list. A test fails while the mechanism is "none".

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require new tests plus fmt, clippy, test.
Criteria check the status line and spec gap behavior by running tests.
Reuse the existing Restart record; one focused change.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs (Manager::restart, RestartArgs), crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS, StatusView.restarts, test oly_b_o5_01_...), crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs (the `restarts` line), crates/athena-data/src/records.rs (Restart, AnyRecord::Restart canonical path records/restarts/). Records validation already accepts athena.restart/1; no new record file under crates/ is created, so check_record_file/AnyRecord unchanged.

Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs, crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs, crates/athena-data/src/records.rs, docs/spec.toml; the change extends the O5-01 restart mechanism rather than building a parallel one.

Interpretation: 'cost logged' = Restart.cost/minutes/tokens, 'anything lost' = Restart.lost, 'causes fixed in Athena' = Restart.via; the new status line summarizes totals and restarts with lost items but no fix.
No refusal rule is added; `athena restart` keeps accepting current inputs.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml OLY-B-O5-02 has a mechanism other than "none" naming manage.rs, status.rs and display.rs, owner "Athena", and a measure ending in `status: <label>` where the label is a line `athena status` prints (new label added to STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs).

Run `cargo test -p athena-core`: a new test (modelled on oly_b_o5_01_...) parses docs/spec.toml, asserts the mechanism/owner/measure, passes hestia::measure_problem, and asserts that with mechanism set to "none" spec_gaps reports it as no_mechanism (fails without the mechanism).

Run `cargo test`: a test records restarts with cost, lost and via via Manager::restart and asserts the new status view field and the printed line in crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs show restarts with cost, losses logged and causes fixed in Athena (counts of restarts lacking a fix are visible), measured directly from records.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` all pass, including the existing every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line test.

No new record schema file is added (the existing athena.restart/1 Restart in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs is reused), so AnyRecord and the round-trip tests are unaffected; if a field is added, the round-trip test is updated.
